units.text: On that day I will seek to remove all the nations coming against Jerusalem.

I will pour upon David’s house and Jerusalem’s residents a spirit of grace and compassion. They will look toward Me because they danced in mockery, and mourn over him as over a beloved one; they will suffer grief as over a firstborn.
On that day mourning in Jerusalem will grow great, like mourning over a pomegranate grove cut down in a plain,

and the land will mourn tribe by tribe, each tribe by itself and their wives by themselves: the tribe of David’s house by itself and their wives by themselves; the tribe of Nathan’s house by itself and their wives by themselves;
the tribe of Levi’s house by itself and their wives by themselves; the tribe of Simeon by itself and their wives by themselves;
all the tribes remaining, each tribe by itself and their wives by themselves.
On that day every place will be opened in David’s house.
On that day, says the Lord, I will destroy the idols’ names from the land, and there will no longer be remembrance of them. I will remove the false prophets and the unclean spirit from the land.

If a person still prophesies, his father and mother who begot him will say to him, ‘You shall not live, because you spoke falsehoods in the Lord’s name.’ His father and mother who begot him will bind his feet when he prophesies.
On that day the prophets will be ashamed, each because of his vision when he prophesies; they will wear a hairy skin because they lied.
He will say, ‘I am no prophet; I am a man who works the earth, because a man begot me from my youth.’
I will say to him, ‘What are these wounds between your hands?’ He will say, ‘The ones with which I was struck in my beloved house.’
Sword, awake against My shepherds, against the man who is My fellow citizen, says the Lord Almighty! Strike the shepherds and tear away the sheep; I will bring My hand against the shepherds.
Throughout the land, says the Lord, the two parts will be destroyed and fail, but the third will remain in it.

I will lead the third through fire, refine them with fire as silver is refined and test them as gold is tested. He will call on My name, and I will listen to him and say, ‘This is My people,’ and he will say, ‘The Lord is my God.’”
Look, days of the Lord are coming, and your spoils will be divided within you.

I will gather all the nations against Jerusalem for war. The city will be captured, the houses plundered and the women violated. Half the city will go into captivity, but the remnant of My people will certainly not be destroyed from the city.
The Lord will go out and draw up for battle among those nations, as on the day of His battle formation on a day of war.

On that day His feet will stand on the Mount of Olives opposite Jerusalem to the east. The Mount of Olives will split, half of it toward the east and half toward the sea—a very great chasm; half the mountain will incline north and half south.

The ravine of My mountains will be blocked; the mountain ravine will be joined as far as Iasol and blocked as it was blocked in the days of the earthquake, in the days of Oziah king of Judah. The Lord my God will come, and all the holy ones with Him.
On that day there will be no light, cold or ice.
It will last one day, and that day is known to the Lord, neither day nor night; toward evening there will be light.
On that day living water will go out from Jerusalem, half into the first sea and half into the last sea; it will be so in summer and spring.
The Lord will be king over all the earth. On that day the Lord will be one, and His name one,

encircling all the land and the wilderness from Gabe to Remmon south of Jerusalem. Rama will remain in its place, from Benjamin’s Gate to the place of the First Gate, to the Gate of Corners and to Ananeel’s Tower, to the king’s wine vats.
They will dwell in her; there will no longer be anything accursed, and Jerusalem will dwell confidently.

This will be the downfall with which the Lord will strike all the peoples who marched against Jerusalem: their flesh will melt while they stand on their feet; their eyes will flow from their sockets, and their tongue will melt in their mouth.
On that day great bewilderment from the Lord will be upon them. Each will seize his neighbor’s hand, and his hand will grapple with his neighbor’s hand.
Judah will draw up for battle in Jerusalem and gather the strength of all the surrounding peoples: gold, silver and clothing in very great abundance.
This will also be the downfall of horses, mules, camels, donkeys and every animal in those camps, according to this downfall.
Whoever remains from all the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up each year to bow before the King, the Lord Almighty, and celebrate the Festival of Tent-Pitching.
Whoever among all the earth’s tribes does not go up to Jerusalem to bow before the King, the Lord Almighty—these will be added to those.
If Egypt’s tribe does not go up or come there, upon these too will be the downfall with which the Lord will strike all the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Festival of Tent-Pitching.
This will be Egypt’s sin and the sin of all the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Festival of Tent-Pitching.
On that day what is upon the horse’s bridle will be holy to the Lord Almighty, and the cauldrons in the Lord’s house will be like bowls before the altar.

Every cauldron in Jerusalem and Judah will be holy to the Lord Almighty. All who sacrifice will come, take some of them and boil in them. No Canaanite will remain in the house of the Lord Almighty on that day.
